  'If you have A HEADACHE, you should
   go to A CHEMIST.'

     muammolar)

     (o'rtacha muammolar)

  a dentist = tish shifokori

  a headache - bosh og'rig'i
  toothache - tish og'rig'i
  earache - quloq og'rig'i
  stomach ache - qorin og'rig'i

  ⚠ 'headache' SANALADIGAN
  ('a headache'), qolganlari odatda
  sanalmaydigan.


⚠ 'A COLD' va 'THE FLU':

  a cold = shamollash ('A' bilan)
  the flu = gripp ('THE' bilan)
  ⚠ 'I have A cold' / 'I have THE
  flu'.


⚠ 'A SORE THROAT':

  = tomoq og'rig'i.
  ⚠ 'sore' = og'riydigan.
  ⚠ 'throat' o'qilishi /θrəʊt/.


⚠ 'A BURN':

  = kuyish.
  ⚠ 'to burn' = yonmoq, kuymoq.


⚠ 'DISEASE' va 'ILLNESS':

  disease = aniq kasallik (tibbiy)
  illness = kasallik holati (umumiy)
  ⚠ 'disease' o'qilishi /dɪˈziːz/.

tasks.en: 34-year-old Dianne Grey was a successful doctor in the south of England, but for the last eight months she has been living in Angola, working for an organisation called Doctors Without Frontiers that provides emergency health care in several African countries.

tasks.en: Dianne was a GP in Horsham, Surrey. She had a good career ahead of her and a comfortable life, but she began to find her job rather boring.

tasks.en: She says, "I was treating patients with routine medical problems - colds, sore throats and so on - and I felt a need to do something more important."
tasks.uz: U aytadi: "Men oddiy tibbiy muammoli bemorlarni davolardim - shamollash, tomoq og'rig'i va hokazo - va muhimroq narsa qilish zaruratini his qildim".

⚠ 'and so on' = va hokazo.
⚠ 'to feel a need to' = zarurat sezmoq.

tasks.en: The organisation she works for has been sending medical teams and equipment to Angola since 1986. Various armies have been fighting each other in the area for decades, and standards of health care have grown worse and worse.
tasks.uz: U ishlaydigan tashkilot 1986 yildan beri Angolaga tibbiy jamoalar va jihozlar yuborib kelmoqda. Turli armiyalar bu hududda o'n yillar davomida bir-biri bilan jang qilmoqda va tibbiy xizmat darajasi tobora yomonlashgan.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'SINCE 1986' (boshlanish nuqtasi) va
'FOR decades' (davomiylik).
⚠ 'worse and worse' = tobora yomon.
⚠ 'equipment' - SANALMAYDIGAN.

tasks.en: Outside the cities there aren't enough hospitals, clinics, doctors or nurses, and many diseases have become a major problem.
tasks.uz: Shaharlardan tashqarida kasalxona, klinika, shifokor va hamshiralar yetarli emas va ko'p kasalliklar jiddiy muammoga aylangan.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'enough' + ot: 'enough hospitals'.
⚠ 'HAVE BECOME' - present perfect: natija hozir.

tasks.en: At first Dianne was shocked, but she has been working hard to improve conditions there. During her time in Angola, she has treated thousands of patients and has been training local people as health care workers.
tasks.uz: Avvaliga Dianne hayratda edi, lekin u yerdagi sharoitni yaxshilash uchun qattiq ishlab kelmoqda. Angoladagi vaqti davomida u minglab bemorni davoladi va mahalliy aholini tibbiy xodim sifatida o'qitib kelmoqda.
tasks.note:

⚠ 'HAS TREATED thousands' (NATIJA - soni) va
'HAS BEEN TRAINING' (JARAYoN - davom etyapti).
⚠ 'to train sb AS' = ... sifatida o'qitmoq.

tasks.en: "Working here has been a very meaningful experience," she says. "I have never felt so useful before. It's so great to know that we have been helping people who really need it."
tasks.uz: "Bu yerda ishlash juda ma'noli tajriba bo'ldi, - deydi u. - Men hech qachon o'zimni bunchalik foydali his qilmaganman. Haqiqatan muhtoj odamlarga yordam berib kelayotganimizni bilish juda ajoyib".
tasks.note:
⚠ 'I have NEVER felt ... BEFORE' - present
perfect + never.
⚠ 'meaningful' = ma'noli, ahamiyatli.
⚠ 'so useful' = shunchalik foydali.

tasks.en: She will be leaving Angola next month, but she has already decided to return to Africa as soon as possible.
tasks.uz: U kelasi oy Angoladan ketadi, lekin imkon qadar tezroq Afrikaga qaytishga allaqachon qaror qilgan.

tasks.en: Bill Gates
tasks.uz: Bill Gates

tasks.en: [1] Everyone has heard of Bill Gates, one of the richest and most successful people in the world. Microsoft, the business he started with a friend in 1975, has become the world's largest computer software company, and Gates was the world's youngest billionaire at the age of 31.
tasks.uz: [1] Bill Gates haqida hamma eshitgan - u dunyodagi eng boy va eng muvaffaqiyatli odamlardan biri. U 1975 yilda do'sti bilan boshlagan Microsoft kompaniyasi dunyodagi eng katta kompyuter dasturlari kompaniyasiga aylandi va Gates 31 yoshida dunyodagi eng yosh milliarder edi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'HAS HEARD OF' - 'hear of' = ... haqida
eshitmoq.
⚠ 'the business (that) he started' - 'that'
tushirilgan.
⚠ 'at the age of 31' = 31 yoshida.

tasks.en: [2] His full name is William Henry Gates III, and he was born on 28th October, 1955, in Seattle, USA. At school, Bill soon showed that he was very intelligent, and especially good at Maths and Science.
tasks.uz: [2] Uning to'liq ismi - Uilyam Genri Geyts III, u 1955 yil 28-oktabrda AQShning Sietl shahrida tug'ilgan. Maktabda Bill tez orada juda aqlli ekanini, ayniqsa matematika va fanlarda kuchli ekanini ko'rsatdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'was born ON 28th October' - sana oldidan 'on'.
⚠ 'good AT Maths' - 'at' predlogi.
⚠ 'especially' = ayniqsa.

tasks.en: His parents decided to send him to Lakeside, the private school where he first began to use computers. 13-year-old Bill Gates and his schoolfriend Paul Allen were soon spending all their time writing programs and learning about computers instead of doing their schoolwork!
tasks.uz: Ota-onasi uni Lakeside xususiy maktabiga yuborishga qaror qildi - u yerda u birinchi marta kompyuterdan foydalana boshladi. 13 yoshli Bill Gates va maktabdosh do'sti Pol Allen tez orada butun vaqtini maktab ishlari o'rniga dastur yozish va kompyuterni o'rganishga sarflay boshladi!
tasks.note:
⚠ 'a private school' = xususiy maktab.
⚠ 'instead of' + -ING.
⚠ 'were spending' - PAST CONTINUOUS.

tasks.en: [3] After finishing school in 1973, Bill went to Harvard, America's most famous university. The next year, he and Paul Allen wrote an operating program for the Altair, one of the world's first microcomputers.
tasks.uz: [3] 1973 yilda maktabni tugatgach, Bill Amerikaning eng mashhur universiteti Harvardga kirdi. Keyingi yili u va Pol Allen dunyodagi birinchi mikrokompyuterlardan biri - Altair uchun operatsion dastur yozdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'After finishING' - 'after' + -ING.
⚠ 'an operating program' = operatsion dastur.
⚠ 'wrote' - aniq vaqt ('the next year').

tasks.en: The two friends started Microsoft in 1975, and Gates left Harvard. Before long, Microsoft was a major business success. Since then, the company has continued to grow, producing most of the world's leading PC software.
tasks.uz: Ikki do'st 1975 yilda Microsoftni boshladi va Gates Harvardni tashlab ketdi. Ko'p o'tmay Microsoft katta biznes muvaffaqiyatiga aylandi. O'shandan beri kompaniya o'sishda davom etib, dunyodagi yetakchi shaxsiy kompyuter dasturlarining ko'pini ishlab chiqarmoqda.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'before long' = ko'p o'tmay.
⚠ 'SINCE THEN, the company HAS CONTINUED' -
present perfect + since.
⚠ 'leading' = yetakchi.

tasks.en: One reason for his success is that Gates has always been very ambitious and hardworking. This has not left him much time for a normal personal life, but in 1994 he married Melinda French, a Microsoft employee, and in 1995 he wrote a best-selling book, The Road Ahead.
tasks.uz: Muvaffaqiyatining bir sababi - Gates har doim juda intiluvchan va mehnatkash bo'lgan. Bu unga oddiy shaxsiy hayot uchun ko'p vaqt qoldirmadi, lekin 1994 yilda u Microsoft xodimi Melinda Frenchga uylandi va 1995 yilda 'The Road Ahead' nomli eng ko'p sotilgan kitobni yozdi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'HAS always BEEN' - 'always' o'rtada.
⚠ 'to marry sb' - PREDLOGSIZ ('married WITH'
XATO).
⚠ 'best-selling' = eng ko'p sotiladigan.

tasks.en: [4] Bill has mixed feelings about spending so much time running Microsoft. "There are a lot of experiences I haven't had, but I do like my job," he says. When he does find time to relax, he likes puzzles, golf and reading about science.
tasks.uz: [4] Bill Microsoftni boshqarishga shuncha vaqt sarflash haqida aralash his-tuyg'ularga ega. "Men boshdan kechirmagan ko'p tajribalar bor, lekin ishimni haqiqatan yaxshi ko'raman", - deydi u. Dam olishga vaqt topganda u boshqotirmalar, golf va fan haqida o'qishni yoqtiradi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'mixed feelings' = aralash his-tuyg'ular.
⚠ 'to run a company' = kompaniyani boshqarmoq.
⚠ 'I DO like' - 'do' urg'u uchun: haqiqatan.
⚠ 'experiences (that) I haven't had'.

tasks.en: For such a rich person, his life is simple, and he spends little on himself and his family. When it comes to helping others, though, Gates is very generous. He has already given huge amounts of money to charity, and says that he plans to give away almost all of his wealth when he retires.
tasks.uz: Bunday boy odam uchun uning hayoti oddiy va u o'ziga va oilasiga kam sarflaydi. Lekin boshqalarga yordam berishga kelganda Gates juda saxiy. U allaqachon xayriyaga katta miqdorda pul bergan va nafaqaga chiqqanida deyarli butun boyligini berib yuborishni rejalashtirayotganini aytadi.
tasks.note:
⚠ 'when it comes to' = ... ga kelganda.
⚠ 'generous' = saxiy.
⚠ 'charity' = xayriya.
⚠ 'to give away' = berib yubormoq (tekin).
⚠ 'when he RETIRES' - vaqt ergash gapida
present simple.

exercises.instructionEn: We use for to express duration: I have known Sue for ten years. We use since to state a starting point: She hasn't been to New York since 1992.     Lisbon. (hali Lissabonda)

exercises.instructionEn: Present Perfect (have/has + past participle) — Use
exercises.instructionUz: Present Perfect (have/has + o'tgan zamon sifatdoshi) — Ishlatilishi
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT PERFECT - 7-UNITNING ASOSIY
GRAMMATIKASI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLI                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  have/has + 3-ShAKL (past
  participle)

  I/you/we/they HAVE broken
  he/she/it HAS broken

  QISQARTMA: I've, you've, he's,
     she's, we've, they've
  INKOR: haven't / hasn't
  SAVOL: Have you ...? / Has he ...?

  ⚠ "he's" = 'he HAS' (present
  perfect) yoki 'he IS' - kontekst
  ochib beradi: "He's broken" →
  has; "He's tall" → is.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  TO'RT IShLATILIShI              ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  1) O'TMIShDA BOShLANIB HOZIRGAChA
     DAVOM ETADI:
     'Dianne HAS BEEN in Angola FOR
      the last eight months.'
     (hali ham u yerda)

  2) YaQINDA BO'LGAN, NATIJASI
     HOZIR KO'RINIB TURIBDI:
     "I'VE BROKEN my leg, so I
      can't walk."
     (oyoq hozir singan)

  3) TAJRIBA (hayotda biror marta):
     'HAVE you ever BEEN to Angola?'

  4) VAQTI AYTILMAGAN o'tmish
     harakati - VAQT emas, HARAKAT
     muhim:
     "He'S BEEN to the dentist's
      four times."


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  VAQT SO'ZLARI                   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  just - hozirgina
  already - allaqachon
  yet - hali (inkor/savol)
  for - ... davomida (for 2 years)
  since - ... dan beri (since 1986)
  recently / lately - yaqinda
  so far - hozirgacha
  ever - biror marta (savol)
  never - hech qachon


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  PRESENT PERFECT va PAST SIMPLE  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  PAST SIMPLE - vaqt AYTILGAN:
     'I broke my leg LAST WEEK.'
  PRESENT PERFECT - vaqt AYTILMAGAN
  yoki hozirga bog'liq:
     "I've broken my leg." (hozir
      yura olmayman)

  ⚠ 'yesterday', 'last week', 'in
  1990', 'ago' bilan HECh QAChON
  present perfect ishlatilmaydi!


⚠ 'HAVE BEEN TO' va 'HAVE GONE TO':

  "He's BEEN to the dentist's" =
     borib QAYTGAN
  "He's GONE to the dentist's" =
     ketgan, HALI QAYTMAGAN


⚠ "THE DENTIST'S":

  = tish shifokorining (xonasi).
  ⚠ 'the dentist's', 'the doctor's',
  'the chemist's' - egalik bilan
  JOY ma'nosida.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the past participle of the following verbs.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi fe'llarning o'tgan zamon sifatdoshini (3-shaklini) yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAROHAT FE'LLARI - 3-ShAKL.


NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR (yodlash kerak):

  break - broke - BROKEN
  cut - cut - CUT
  hurt - hurt - HURT
  hit - hit - HIT
  burn - burnt - BURNT (Britaniya)
         burned - burned (AQSh)


TO'G'RI FE'LLAR (+ed):

  twist - TWISTED (burab olmoq)
  bang - BANGED (urib olmoq)
  scratch - SCRATCHED (tirnamoq)
  crack - CRACKED (darz ketmoq)
  treat - TREATED (davolamoq)
  sprain - SPRAINED (chiqarib olmoq)
  cure - CURED (sog'aytirmoq)


⚠ 'CUT', 'HURT', 'HIT' - UCh ShAKL
  BIR XIL:

  ⚠ Bularda '-ed' QO'ShILMAYDI:
  'cutted', 'hurted', 'hitted' -
  XATO!


⚠ 'BURNT' va 'BURNED':

  Britaniyada 'burnt' ko'proq,
  AQShda 'burned'.
  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri.


⚠ 'TO TWIST' va 'TO SPRAIN':

  twist = burab olmoq (to'piq)
  sprain = chiqarib olmoq (bo'g'im)
  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham 'ankle' bilan
  ishlatiladi.


⚠ 'TO BANG':

  = qattiq urib olmoq.
  ⚠ 'to bang your head' = boshingni
  urib olmoq.


⚠ 'TO CRACK':

  = darz ketmoq/ketkazmoq.
  ⚠ 'a cracked rib' = darz ketgan
  qovurg'a.

exercises.instructionEn: Just · Already · Yet
exercises.instructionUz: Just · Already · Yet
exercises.explanationUz:
PRESENT PERFECT BILAN UCh SO'Z.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ALREADY = allaqachon            ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  TASDIQ gapda, 'have' va 3-shakl
  ORASIDA:
  "I've ALREADY booked my flight."


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  JUST = hozirgina                 ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  TASDIQ gapda, 'have' va 3-shakl
  ORASIDA:
  "I've JUST broken the vase."


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  YET = hali                      ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  SAVOL va INKORda, gap OXIRIDA:
  'Have you done the shopping YET?'
  "She hasn't phoned her mother YET."


⚠ O'RNI - ENG MUHIM:

  already/just → O'RTADA
     (have ___ done)
  yet → OXIRIDA
     (... done ___?)

  ⚠ "I've done it already" ham
  mumkin, lekin o'rtada odatiy.


⚠ 'YET' - TASDIQDA IShLATILMAYDI:

  ✗ "I've done it yet."
  ✓ "I've already done it."


⚠ 'TO BOOK A FLIGHT':

  = reysga chipta bron qilmoq.
  ⚠ 'to book' = bron qilmoq.


⚠ 'A VASE':

  = vaza (gul uchun).
  ⚠ Britaniyada /vɑːz/,
  AQShda /veɪs/.

tasks.en: We use already or just in positive statements.

tasks.en: I've just broken the vase.
tasks.uz: Men hozirgina vazani sindirib qo'ydim.

tasks.en: We use yet in questions and negations.
tasks.uz: 'yet' ni savol va inkor gaplarda ishlatamiz.

exercises.instructionEn: Present Perfect Simple vs Past Simple
exercises.instructionUz: Present Perfect Simple va Past Simple
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI ZAMON FARQI - ENG MUHIM MAVZU.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  PRESENT PERFECT                 ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  1) VAQTI AYTILMAGAN:
     'I HAVE BEEN to Angola.'
     (Qachon? Bilmaymiz - muhim
      emas)

  2) O'TMIShDA BOShLANIB HOZIR HAM
     DAVOM ETADI:
     'He HAS BEEN ill for a week.'
     (o'tgan hafta kasal edi va
      HALI HAM kasal)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  PAST SIMPLE                     ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  TUGAGAN harakat, VAQTI AYTILGAN
  yoki MA'LUM:
     'He WROTE his third novel in
      1998.' (Qachon? 1998 da)


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  TEZ TEKShIRUV                   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  Gapda ANIQ O'TGAN VAQT bormi?
     (yesterday, last week, in 1998,
      two days ago, when I was five)
     → PAST SIMPLE

  Vaqt yo'q yoki hozirgacha davom
  etadi?
     (ever, never, just, already,
      yet, for, since, so far)
     → PRESENT PERFECT


⚠ O'ZBEKChA BILAN FARQ:

  O'zbekchada ikkalasi ham '-di' /
  '-gan' bilan ifodalanadi:
  'Angolada bo'lganman' (perfect)
  '1998 da yozdi' (past)
  ⚠ Ingliz tilida VAQT belgisi
  zamonni belgilaydi.


⚠ 'A NOVEL':

  = roman.
  ⚠ 'a novelist' = yozuvchi.

tasks.uz: Present Perfect Simple va Past Simple

tasks.en: We use the present perfect simple for an action which happened at an unstated time in the past or which started in the past and continues to the present.
tasks.uz: Present perfect simple ni o'tmishda aytilmagan vaqtda bo'lgan yoki o'tmishda boshlanib hozirgacha davom etayotgan harakat uchun ishlatamiz.
tasks.note: ⚠ Ikki holat: vaqt yo'q / hali davom etadi.

tasks.en: I have been to Angola. (When? We don't know.)
tasks.uz: Men Angolada bo'lganman. (Qachon? Bilmaymiz.)

tasks.en: He has been ill for a week. (He was ill last week and he still is.)
tasks.uz: U bir haftadan beri kasal. (O'tgan hafta kasal edi va hali ham kasal.)
tasks.note:
⚠ 'for a week' - davom etadi.

PRESENT PERFECT CONTINUOUS.

║  ShAKLI                          ║

  have/has + BEEN + fe'l-ING

  qarab o'zgarmaydi.

║  IKKI IShLATILIShI               ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  1) O'TMIShDA BOShLANIB HOZIR
     DAVOM ETADI - DAVOMIYLIKKA

     'The organisation HAS BEEN
      SENDING medical teams since
      1986.'
     (qancha VAQT - muhim)

     KO'RINIB TURIBDI:
     "I'm dirty because I'VE BEEN
      WORKING in the garden."

      natijasi)

║  SIMPLE va CONTINUOUS FARQI      ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  SIMPLE - NATIJA / SONI:
     'She HAS TREATED thousands of
      patients.' (nechta - muhim)

     'She HAS BEEN TREATING patients
      for eight months.' (qancha
      vaqt - muhim)

  ⚠ 'How many?' → simple
  ⚠ 'How long?' → continuous


⚠ HOLAT FE'LLARI:

  know, like, love, have (egalik),
  be - continuous'da IShLATILMAYDI:
  ✗ 'I have been knowing him'
  ✓ 'I have known him for years'

  = urg'u.
  ⚠ 'to give emphasis to' = urg'u
  bermoq.

PROFIL YoZISh QOIDASI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  TO'RT XATBOShI                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  1) KIRISh - kim va nima uchun
     muhim
     'Everyone has heard of ...'

  2) BOLALIK - qachon/qayerda
     tug'ilgan, bolalik, maktab
     'He was born on ... in ...'

  3) KEYINGI HAYOT - karyera, muhim
     voqealar XRONOLOGIK tartibda
     'In 1975 ... Since then ...'

  4) XARAKTER, YoQTIRGAN NARSALAR,
     REJALAR
     'He is ambitious ... He likes
      ... He plans to ...'

  = xronologik tartib (vaqt bo'yicha,
  eskidan yangiga).
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˌkrɒnəˈlɒdʒɪkl/ -
  'ch' → /k/.


⚠ 'TO ATTEND':

  = qatnashmoq, o'qimoq (maktabda).
  ⚠ 'the school he attended' =
  u o'qigan maktab.
  ⚠ 'attend TO' - XATO (predlogsiz).


⚠ 'CHILDHOOD':

  = bolalik.
  ⚠ 'child' + '-hood'.


⚠ 52-BETDAGI BILL GATES MATNI -
  AYNI ShU TUZILISh (22a mashqda

tasks.en: When we write a profile of a famous person we usually divide it into four paragraphs.
tasks.uz: Mashhur odam profilini yozganda uni odatda to'rt xatboshiga bo'lamiz.

tasks.en: In the first paragraph, we write who the person is and why he/she is important.
tasks.uz: Birinchi xatboshida odam kim ekani va nima uchun muhimligini yozamiz.

tasks.en: In the second paragraph, we write about the person's early life (i.e. when and where he/she was born, his/her childhood, the school he/she attended, etc.).
tasks.uz: Ikkinchi xatboshida odamning bolaligi haqida yozamiz (ya'ni qachon va qayerda tug'ilgani, bolaligi, o'qigan maktabi va h.k.).

tasks.en: In the third paragraph, we write about the person's later life, (i.e. his/her career and important events in his/her life, in chronological order).
tasks.uz: Uchinchi xatboshida odamning keyingi hayoti haqida yozamiz (ya'ni karyerasi va hayotidagi muhim voqealar, xronologik tartibda).

tasks.en: In the last paragraph, we write about the person's character, likes and plans.
tasks.uz: Oxirgi xatboshida odamning xarakteri, yoqtirgan narsalari va rejalari haqida yozamiz.

sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men hech qachon o'zimni bunchalik foydali his qilmaganman.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Ega] has/have + 3-ShAKL + for [davomiylik].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Dianne has been in Angola for the last eight months.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Dianne so'nggi sakkiz oy Angolada.

sentencePatterns.formula: I've + 3-ShAKL ..., so [natija].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I've broken my leg, so I can't walk.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Oyog'imni sindirib oldim, shuning uchun yura olmayman.

sentencePatterns.formula: Have you ever + 3-ShAKL ...?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Have you ever been to Angola?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hech Angolada bo'lganmisiz?

sentencePatterns.formula: What's the problem? - I've + 3-ShAKL + my [tana a'zosi].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What's the problem, Mr Ellis? - I've twisted my ankle.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nima bo'ldi, janob Ellis? - To'pig'imni burab oldim.

sentencePatterns.formula: What's the matter? - I've got [kasallik]. - Why don't you [maslahat], then?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What's the matter, Steve? - I've got a headache. - Why don't you take an aspirin, then?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nima bo'ldi, Stiv? - Boshim og'riyapti. - Unda aspirin ichsang-chi?

sentencePatterns.formula: [Ega] has already + 3-ShAKL.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He has already made his bed.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U allaqachon karavotini yig'gan.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Ega] hasn't + 3-ShAKL ... yet.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He hasn't picked the papers up yet.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U hali qog'ozlarni yig'magan.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Ega] has just + 3-ShAKL.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The plane has just taken off.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Samolyot hozirgina ko'tarildi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Have you ever + 3-ShAKL? - Yes, I have. When? - I + PAST SIMPLE + when ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Have you ever had measles? - Yes, I have. - When? - I had measles when I was five.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hech qizamiq bo'lganmisiz? - Ha. - Qachon? - Besh yoshimda qizamiq bo'lganman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Tajriba → present perfect; vaqt aytilganda
→ past simple.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Ega] has/have been + -ING + all [vaqt].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She has been walking all morning.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U butun ertalab yurgan.

sentencePatterns.formula: How long have you been + -ING? - I've been + -ING for/since ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How long have you been studying French? - I've been studying French for seven years.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qancha vaqtdan beri fransuz tilini o'rganyapsiz? - Yetti yildan beri.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Kim] was born on [sana], in [joy].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He was born on 28th October, 1955, in Seattle, USA.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U 1955 yil 28-oktabrda AQShning Sietl shahrida tug'ilgan.

sentencePatterns.formula: Since then, [ega] has + 3-ShAKL.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Since then, the company has continued to grow.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: O'shandan beri kompaniya o'sishda davom etmoqda.

sentencePatterns.formula: Can I ...? / Is it alright if I ...? - Have you + 3-ShAKL ... yet?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Can I go out? - Have you done your homework yet?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Chiqsam bo'ladimi? - Uy vazifangni qilib bo'ldingmi?

sentencePatterns.formula: [Ish] first, and then you can [fe'l].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Wash the dishes first, and then you can play on your computer.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Avval idishlarni yuv, keyin kompyuterda o'ynasang bo'ladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Everyone has heard of [kim], one of the greatest [kim] in [soha].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Everyone has heard of Martina Hingis, one of the greatest tennis players in the history of women's tennis.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Martina Hingis haqida hamma eshitgan - ayollar tennisi tarixidagi eng buyuk o'yinchilardan biri.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Kim] started + -ING at the age of [son].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She started playing tennis at the age of three.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U uch yoshida tennis o'ynay boshlagan.

sentencePatterns.formula: [Kim] moved to [joy] and has lived there ever since.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She moved to Switzerland and has lived there ever since.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U Shveytsariyaga ko'chgan va o'shandan beri u yerda yashaydi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ PAST SIMPLE (moved) + PRESENT PERFECT (has lived
ever since).

sentencePatterns.formula: When [kim] retires, she'd like to [fe'l].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When she retires from tennis, she'd like to keep horses.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tennisdan ketganida ot boqishni xohlaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + has / have + V3
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Tom has broken his arm. They have travelled through Europe.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tom qo'lini sindirib olgan. Ular Yevropa bo'ylab sayohat qilishgan.

sentencePatterns.formula: Has / Have + KIM + V3? — KIM + hasn't / haven't + V3
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Has he bought a new car? He hasn't bought a new car.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U yangi mashina sotib oldimi? U yangi mashina sotib olmagan.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + has been + ... + since + NUQTA / for + MUDDAT
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Kim has been a chef since 1985.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kim 1985-yildan beri oshpaz.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + has / have + already / just + V3 — Has + KIM + V3 + yet?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She's already booked a table. I've just bought a new dress. Has Jim fixed the car yet?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U allaqachon stol band qilgan. Endigina ko'ylak sotib oldim. Jim mashinani tuzatdimi hali?

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + has gone to + JOY (hali o'sha yerda) / KIM + has been to + JOY (qaytgan)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Thomas and Anne have gone to Lisbon. I have been to Lisbon.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Tomas va Enn Lissabonga ketishgan. Men Lissabonda bo'lganman.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + V2 + in 1997 / ago (Past Simple) — KIM + has V3 + for/since (Present Perfect)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Fred graduated in 1997. He has been a teacher for twenty years.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Fred 1997-yilda bitirgan. U yigirma yildan beri o'qituvchi.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + has / have been + V-ing + for + MUDDAT
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She has been typing letters for three hours.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U uch soatdan beri xat yozyapti.

sentencePatterns.formula: HOLAT. Have / Has + KIM + V3 ...? — No, ... haven't / hasn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The flowers are dry. Has Ann watered them? — No, she hasn't.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Gullar qurigan. Enn ularni sug'ordimi? — Yo'q.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + has gone to + JOY (hali u yerda) / KIM + has been to + JOY (qaytgan)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Dad has been to the supermarket. The fridge is full. Marie has gone to the shops.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Dadam supermarketga borib keldi. Muzlatgich to'la. Mari do'konga ketgan.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + has / have + V3 + for + MUDDAT / since + NUQTA
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Mary has been a nurse for seven years. I haven't been to the city since October.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Meri yetti yildan beri hamshira. Oktabrdan beri shaharga bormadim.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + has / have + just / already + V3 — KIM + hasn't / haven't + V3 + yet
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He has just left for work. I haven't finished it yet.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U endigina ishga ketdi. Hali tugatmadim.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + has / have been + V-ing + for / since ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He has been studying since 4:00. She has been exercising for 6 months.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U soat 4 dan beri o'qiyapti. U 6 oydan beri mashq qilyapti.

sentencePatterns.formula: Why are you tired? — I have been + V-ing.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Why are you tired? — I have been playing football.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nega charchadingiz? — Futbol o'ynab keldim.

sentencePatterns.formula: How long has / have + KIM + been + V-ing? — ... for / since ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: How long has Lisa been living in this house? — She has been living here for ten years.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Liza bu uyda qancha vaqtdan beri yashaydi? — O'n yildan beri.

sentencePatterns.formula: Why is + KIM + HOLAT? — ... is + HOLAT + because + KIM + has + V3.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Why is Harold proud? — Harold is proud because he has caught his first fish.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Harold nega faxrlanyapti? — Chunki u birinchi balig'ini tutdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Have you ever + V3 ...? — Yes, I + V2 + ... ago.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Have you ever been to Paris? — Yes, we spent a month there two years ago.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Parijda bo'lganmisiz? — Ha, ikki yil oldin bir oy bo'ldik.

sentencePatterns.formula: Has + KIM + V3 ...? — Yes, ... + V2 + this morning / last summer.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Has Mum spoken to Jim? — Yes, she called him this morning.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Oyim Jim bilan gaplashdimi? — Ha, u bugun ertalab qo'ng'iroq qildi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Umumiy savol - Perfect; aniq vaqt - Past.

sentencePatterns.formula: KIM + has been + V-ing + for ... and so far + KIM + has + V3 + SON
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Ann has been writing books for more than fifteen years and so far she has published eleven books.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Enn o'n besh yildan ortiq kitob yozib keladi va hozirgacha o'n bitta kitob nashr etgan.

sentencePatterns.formula: Let's go before + KIM + FE'L(s)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Let's go before it gets dark.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qorong'i tushishidan oldin ketaylik.

sentencePatterns.formula: What's wrong? - I've got + KASALLIK.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What's wrong? - I've got a cough.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Nima bo'ldi? - Yo'talyapman.

sentencePatterns.formula: I've + V3 + my + A'ZO.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I've broken my leg. I've burnt my finger.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Oyog'imni sindirdim. Barmog'imni kuydirdim.

sentencePatterns.formula: You can break/sprain/hurt/cut your + A'ZO.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You can sprain your ankle.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: To'pig'ingizni chiqarib olishingiz mumkin.

sentencePatterns.formula: I have had X for the last two weeks.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I have had a bad cold for the last two weeks.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: So'nggi ikki hafta davomida qattiq shamollab yuribman.

sentencePatterns.formula: I've got + KASALLIK. - Shall I + FE'L for you?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I've got a terrible headache. - Shall I get you an aspirin?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Boshim qattiq og'riyapti. - Aspirin olib kelaymi?

sentencePatterns.formula: Have you ever + V3? - I've + V3. / I've never + V3.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Have you ever broken a bone? - I've never broken a bone.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Suyagingiz singanmi? - Suyagim hech qachon sinmagan.

sentencePatterns.formula: Have you + V3 ... yet? - I've just/already + V3.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Have you seen a doctor yet? - I've just got back from the doctor's.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Shifokorga ko'rindingmi hali? - Hozirgina shifokordan qaytdim.

sentencePatterns.formula: I haven't + V3 + yet.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I haven't finished yet.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Hali tugatmadim.

sentencePatterns.formula: I've + V3 ... - When did you do that? - I did it yesterday.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I've hurt my arm. - When did you do that? - I did it yesterday.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qo'limni shikastladim. - Qachon? - Kecha.

sentencePatterns.formula: X has/have + V3 + oneself.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She's hurt herself.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U o'zini shikastladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X has/have + V3 ... for [davomiylik] / since [nuqta].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: She has lived in Japan for the last three years.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U so'nggi uch yildan beri Yaponiyada yashaydi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X has/have been + V-ing + for/since ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He has been playing tennis for over ten years.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U o'n yildan ortiq tennis o'ynab keladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: X has been + V-ing + since/for ... (jarayon)
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He has been working in comedy since he was fifteen.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U o'n besh yoshidan beri komediyada ishlab keladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: Guess what? I'm in hospital! I've + V3 + my + A'ZO.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Guess what? I'm in hospital! I've broken my leg.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bilasanmi nima bo'ldi? Kasalxonadaman! Oyog'imni sindirdim.

sentencePatterns.formula: It happened on [kun] ... I was + V-ing when ...
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It happened on Sunday morning. I was boiling some water when the pan fell off the stove.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu yakshanba ertalab sodir bo'ldi. Suv qaynatayotganimda idish plitadan tushib ketdi.

sentencePatterns.formula: I'm not allowed to + FE'L.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Now it is in plaster and I'm not allowed to move it.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Endi u gipsda va uni qimirlatishga ruxsat yo'q.
